title: Analyzing Text Representations under Tight Annotation Budgets: Measuring Structural Alignment
reasoning: The paper uses datasets related to toxicity and toxic behavior for text classification tasks. However, its primary focus is on evaluating the quality of text representations and proposing a new metric (SAM) for structural alignment in low-annotation budget scenarios, rather than directly evaluating or benchmarking ethical reasoning, moral principles, or faith-related aspects of language models.
